label: Sketchnotes
summary: Sketchnotes are a note-taking form attributed to Brian Roemmele in Maaike's work. She used them to process a Voicelunch session she missed, working from tweets and quotes shared by others in the community. They function as a way to engage with material secondhand and still make it her own.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike used sketchnotes here not as live documentation but as a creative response to missing a session. She gathered fragments from what others shared, and turned those into visual notes. The act of making sketchnotes became a way of participating in the Voicelunch community even from the outside of an unrecorded, no-replay event.
open_questions: Voicelunch deliberately does not record sessions to keep the space open and safe — sketchnotes based on secondhand tweets raise the question of how faithfully that approach can be captured after the fact.
Maaike frames missing out as part of the magic of Voicelunch, but the sketchnotes suggest a tension between accepting absence and still trying to recover the content.
